_note: Chests and crates (src/dungeon/chests.gd). per_floor_min/max: chests placed at random over a floor's rooms (never the boss room), at most per_room in one room. Room templates may list chest_spawns as [x, y] cells (editor); without them spots along a north wall are chosen, at least clearance cells from doors and spawns. A hero opens a chest with E within open_radius px (plus the hero radius); chests take no hits. drops: weighted table; kind 'perk' rolls a general perk (balance.perks) the opener's class can use. Consumable items will be added as further kinds. Mimiks: from floor mimic_from_floor on, each random chest is a Mimik with mimic_chance (0.16 = about 1 in 6); template mimic_spawns ([x, y] cells, editor) always hold one. A Mimik looks like a chest, bites the opener for mimic_bite damage, fights as enemy_roster 'mimic' (src/data/balance.json) and drops mimic_drops different perks when it falls. Crates: crates_per_room [min,max] in small groups along the walls, crate_hits hits, no loot yet. Chests and crates are solid 32 px cells (layout.obstacles); crates leave the collision when they break.
